Enumerate every explicitly stated discrete payment and every actual plan, system, or fund event needed to interpret a payment patient. A payment record preserves its payer, patient, amount, explicit medium, actual payment date, and service purpose. Paid wages establish a payment but never establish cash; a service interval or annual reference is not a payment date. service_event_id is a nominal reference only to an already trusted observed service event whose actual worker, employer, and kind match the source payment roles and purpose; if more than one event matches, return unread rather than choosing one. A plan record denotes an actual public plan_ event explicitly established by the source, with its sponsor, beneficiaries, purpose, and any genuinely stated date; it is not a financial flag invented for a payee. Null closes an optional property only after checking its absence for that source key. Questions, native targets, remembered identifiers, work alone, and source-absent dates cannot create records or values. Return complete or unread with exact facts witnesses, and enumerate identical stable source keys for every refined read.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
